dragon_breath.description: Deals $damage$ damage to target and sets surrounding enemies on fire.

dragon_crush.description: Interrupts spell casting and deals $damage$ damage to target.

swiftstrike.description: Increases your attack speed by 50% for 12 seconds.

priest_dragon_counterkick.description: Deals $damage$ to target. Can only be used after an enemy dodges or parries one of your attacks. Can't be dodged or parried.

meditation.description: Restores 50% of your mana over 9 seconds.

dwindle.description: Reduces your threat on all targets.

toughen_up.description: Increases your armor by 100% for 10 seconds.

drain_life.description: Does $damage$ damage to target and heals you for 50% of the damage dealt.

teleport.description: Transports yourself to the target destination.

void_lightning.description: Deals $damage$ damage to target and creates an arcane storm that lasts 5 seconds, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

preparation.description: Resets the cooldown of your spells.

void_blast.description: Deals $damage$ damage to target. Increases your arcane damage by 5% for 10 seconds. Stacks up to 8 times.

ponder.description: Causes your next two spells to be instant.

lake_of_fire.description: Spawns a lake of fire that lasts for 6 seconds, causing damage to any enemy that stands in it.

elemental_infusion.description: Increases the damage of your fire and frost spells by 50% for 20 seconds. All your spells cost 50% more mana to cast.

shell.description: Restores 10% of your health and mana and protects you against all damage for 6 seconds, but makes you unable to do anything.

void_blade_storm.description: Inflicts $damage$ damage on up to 3 nearby enemies.

overpower.description: Increases your Strength by 100% for 20 seconds.

blink.description: Teleports you to a random nearby location.

doom.description: Consumes target Weakness and deals $damage$ damage.

swarm.description: Inflicts enemies in the targeted area with a swarm of insects for 8 seconds.

curse_of_inaction.description: Causes target to be unable to do anything for 6 seconds.

chain_lightning.description: Deals $damage$ damage to target and up to 2 nearby other targets.

maliciousness.description: Increases your spell casting speed by 30% for 20 seconds.

witch_pain_and_suffering.description: Deals $damage$ damage to target enemy afflicted by Curse of Corruption and refreshes it to its full duration.

demonic_infusion.description: Infuses your demon minion with more power for 30 seconds.

guardian_demon.description: Summons a Guardian Demon for 30 seconds.

soul_leak.description: Unholy damage you do to target restores health and mana for 20 seconds.

raise_dead.description: Raises a dead humanoid or undead to fight for you.

enfeeblement.description: Slows target casts and melee attacks for 30 seconds.

corpse_explosion.description: Causes targeted corpse to explode and cause damage to surrounding enemies.

extinguish.description: Deals $damage$ damage to target. Restores 20% of your health and mana if this kills the target.

light_follower.description: Become a Follower of The Light.

underworld_follower.description: Become a Follower of The Underworld.
